project.name: Tradeflow review agents
project.summary: Agents that explain a Dhaka Stock Exchange portfolio, check the reasons behind each trade and review a trade before it is saved, citing the query behind every number, so each answer can be audited.

zetaris.how: Named queries with sql() run through Zetaris: week_moves, sector_vs_stock, announcements_between, fundamentals_latest, dividends_between, journal_for_symbol, rule_findings and reconciliation. Each matches its local() function; parity is confirmed.
evidence: npm run parity prints every query's SQL and compares it to local(); docs/zetaris-queries.md says 'parity: match' for every query
A Query trace line with source=zetaris
zetaris.use_case_note: All eight named queries run through Zetaris when the owner's Zetaris account is configured; otherwise they fall back to local rows with source local-fallback.

meterless.how: H-MEM stores the owner's memories (rules, preferences and corrections) in a per-data-dir ledger; World Model records what each run's query results show for each holding. Nightshift is the sole Nemotron provider.
evidence: Memory.recall trace line with retrievalReason and memory ids; src/agent/memory.test.ts tests both paths
World.record trace line before run_end; src/agent/world.test.ts and src/agent/corrections.test.ts pass
Every model_call trace line carries requested_model, routed_model and cost_usd; the four runs used Nightshift as the sole provider
meterless.use_case_note: H-MEM and World Model are standalone reference implementations (no Meterless cloud). Nightshift connects to OpenRouter which serves NVIDIA Nemotron. Markovian engine: not used.

cursor.how: Not used. The organisers allowed any IDE on 22 Oct. Claude Code, run in Orca's terminal, built the agents with the kit in .claude/. The Cursor copy of the kit was removed on 22 Oct.
evidence: .cursor/ and .cursorignore were removed on 22 Oct; the build used .claude/ (Claude Code kit)
cursor.use_case_note: No Cursor job is claimed. The coding-agent kit was copied from .cursor/ to .claude/ before the window opened, and the Cursor copy was removed on 22 Oct.

nvidia.how: Nemotron serves every model call — Planner, Analyst, Evaluator and Writer — through three Nightshift routing tiers. The real runs routed to openrouter/nvidia/nemotron-3.5-lightning, with openrouter/nvidia/nemotron-3-ultra-550b-a55b:free on one retry lane.
evidence: The model_call trace lines in output_examples/traces/ that carry routed_model and cost_usd (51 lines)
output_examples/traces/ has the trace files and the memory ledger of the shipped example runs
nvidia.use_case_note: All Nemotron calls go through Meterless Nightshift (METERLESS_BASE_URL). Development runs used direct OpenRouter; those are not part of the submitted evidence.
